why: Capture today's mail as notes on the tasks they belong to

notes.text:
✉ Etudes en France: Please correct your preconsular file (5 Oct, Campus France Indonesia)

They have checked the file and sent it back for corrections, asked for as soon as possible. Two things: add your ITAS in the identity section, and upload the original bachelor certificate in colour plus your transcripts. The fields are marked "to correct" in the portal. You have to submit the file again before they re-check it, and they warn that each extra round costs time. Dossier reference left out of this note on purpose.

✉ RE: Account Verification (5 Oct, Fitria, Campus France Jakarta)

"We have sent you access to make the requested modifications to the relevant sections. Please let us know once the modifications have been completed." So the portal is open for the corrections above, and they want a note back when you are done.

✉ Etudes en France: Please correct your preconsular file (5 Oct, Campus France Indonesia)

This is the task the correction lands on: they want the original bachelor certificate in colour and the transcripts re-uploaded. Due 18 Oct here, but Campus France asked for it as soon as possible and the EEF validation waits on it.

✉ Fw: Enhance your CV with VMock SMART Career Platform (5 Oct, INSEAD)

The VMock invitation, forwarded from your INSEAD address. This is the access the task is about.

✉ Fw: Your CaseCoach INSEAD Subscription invitation (5 Oct, CaseCoach)

The CaseCoach subscription invitation, forwarded from your INSEAD address. This is the registration the task is about.

✉ Authority to recover legal and valuation charges (3 Oct, sent by you to the branch)

You sent the branch the authority to recover legal and valuation charges against the education loan application, copying your parents. Nothing back from them yet as of this scan.
